items.author: GunnarAK
items.body:
## Problem
The function `detect_file_type()` in `caveman-compress/scripts/detect.py` returns `unknown` for files with the `.mdc` extension (e.g., `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`). This means `.mdc` files are not recognized as natural language (compressible), even though they are human-readable documentation/configuration used in Cursor rules.

## Solution
Add `.mdc` to `COMPRESSIBLE_EXTENSIONS` in `detect.py`:
```python
COMPRESSIBLE_EXTENSIONS = {".md", ".txt", ".markdown", ".rst", ".mdc"}
```
This classifies `.mdc` files as `natural_language`, ensuring they are properly detected for compression.

items.title: detect_file_type() returns 'unknown' for .mdc extension instead of 'natural_language'
